Identity.UUID.name: Identity.UUID
Identity.UUID.description: UUID v4 with automatic base62 encoding for client-facing APIs

Company.name: Company
Company.comment:
A company a person may know by more than one name (D147): Acme Group,
which was Acme. No two companies hold one name, as a name or an alias,
with its case and its runs of spaces ignored; a rename keeps the old
name as an alias, and resolve finds the company a name or an alias
names. Two companies that turn out to be one are merged: the contacts
of the one merged away point at the one that stays, which keeps its
name and aliases as aliases of its own.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The row's name, as a create or a rename gave it: no other row holds it, as a name or an alias, in its normalized form.

CompanyNameAliases.name: CompanyNameAliases
CompanyNameAliases.comment: The row's aliases, one per normalized form: a name it was renamed from, or one addAlias gave it. A removeAlias deletes its row, and a merge moves the row merged away's to the row that stays.

fields.name: company
fields.description: The Company row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: normalized
fields.description: The alias in its normalized form, which keys it within its row.

fields.name: alias
fields.description: The alias as it was given.

CompanyNameNames.name: CompanyNameNames
CompanyNameNames.comment: On a table, one row per name a row holds, as its name or an alias, kept for the table as a whole and keyed by its normalized form, so the database holds each unique: a create or a rename that takes a name another row holds finds its row here. A removed alias and a deleted row's names delete theirs.

fields.name: normalized
fields.description: The name in its normalized form.

fields.name: holder
fields.description: The key of the row that holds the name, as its name or an alias.
